metadata.title: Blue-team methods: why they work, where they fail, weaponizing the guard

entities.name: FIDO2_WebAuthn
entities.notes: Phishing-resistant MFA. Secret never leaves the authenticator. Works vs credential phishing and OTP AiTM. Fails vs session-cookie theft AFTER auth, or compromised authenticator supply chain.

entities.name: EDR_XDR
entities.notes: Endpoint telemetry + behavioral detection. Works vs known malware and many living-off-land patterns. Fails vs BYOVD/EDR-killers, signed-driver abuse, and when the EDR process itself is injectable.

entities.name: Network_Segmentation
entities.notes: Blast-radius limit. Works vs worm/ransomware east-west spread. Fails when identity IS the network (token/TGT replay across segments).

entities.name: Immutable_Backups
entities.notes: Recovery from encryption. Works if backup plane is identity-isolated. Fails if AD/backup-admin is taken first (Conti playbook).

entities.name: Patch_Management
entities.notes: Closes known n-days. Works vs mass KEV exploitation (Exchange Proxy*, MOVEit, VPN). Fails vs 0-day and against orgs that cannot patch appliances.

entities.name: Memory_Safe_Rewrites
entities.notes: Removes a class of bugs (CISA/NSA memory-safety guidance). Works vs memory-corruption worms. Fails vs logic/authz/supply-chain.

entities.name: Allowlisting_PPL
entities.notes: Application control + Protected Process Light for security services. The documented mitigation for DoubleAgent-class verifier-DLL injection into AV.

entities.name: Vulnerable_Driver_Blocklist
entities.notes: Microsoft HVCI/WDAC blocklist vs BYOVD. Coverage lags newly-abused signed drivers (AuKill, EDRKillShifter).

entities.name: SIEM_Detection_Engineering
entities.notes: Log correlation. Works when telemetry exists and detections are tuned. Fails if EDR is killed first or logs are not collected from appliances.

entities.name: Threat_Intel_Sharing
entities.notes: CISA KEV, ISAC, vendor intel. Compresses n-day window. Does not create a 0-day defense.

entities.name: PQC_Migration
entities.notes: Hybrid TLS + ML-KEM/ML-DSA. Works for NEW sessions after cutover. Does not un-harvest old ciphertext (HNDL already incurred).

entities.name: CrowdStrike
entities.notes: EDR/XDR vendor. Dual-use recursion: the same telemetry that defends is a surveillance dataset. July 2024 content-update outage is a concentration-risk exhibit.

entities.name: Mandiant
entities.notes: IR/attribution. Google-owned. APT1 report (2013) first public naming of a PLA unit.

entities.name: Microsoft
entities.notes: OS, identity, mail, EDR (Defender), cloud. Recurring target AND default protector. Dual-use node.

entities.name: CISA
entities.notes: US civilian cyber defense. KEV catalog, joint advisories. Does not operate offensive access.

entities.name: Citizen_Lab
entities.notes: Academic forensic lab (Toronto). Primary public technical source on mercenary spyware.

entities.name: DoubleAgent
entities.notes: 2017 Cybellum: Application Verifier DLL injection into AV processes. Requires prior admin. Mitigation = PPL.

entities.name: BYOVD
entities.notes: Bring-Your-Own-Vulnerable-Driver. Kernel via legitimately signed vulnerable drivers. EDR-killers (AuKill, EDRKillShifter/RansomHub).

edges.notes: Stops phish/OTP; does not stop a helpdesk that will reset a passkey on a phone call (Scattered Spider).
